conventions.name: rpc-method-modules
conventions.description: Each RPC domain module in src/rpc/methods exports a `${name}RpcMethods` map named after the file (registry.ts and schemas.ts are infrastructure, not domain modules).

conventions.name: pi-extension-barrels
conventions.description: Every Pi extension directory exposes a public entry point at index.ts. `shared` is a helper folder, not an extension.

conventions.name: skill-directories
conventions.description: Every agent skill directory carries a SKILL.md manifest.

conventions.name: src-area-topology-doc
conventions.description: Top-level src areas document their architecture in a co-located TOPOLOGY.md (canonical per AGENTS.md).
